note: expected is the exact canonical JSON string. legacyDiffers records whether the non-conformant sort-then-rebuild form produces different bytes for this input; it is documentation, not a requirement.

cases.name: integer-like-keys-reorder
cases.note: The load-bearing case. Sort-then-rebuild loses the sort; direct serialization keeps it.

cases.name: integer-like-keys-nested
cases.note: Same defect one level down, where it is easier to miss in review.

cases.name: vg-set-map-keyed-by-card-number
cases.note: How this reaches Verified Grades in practice: any map keyed by card number, set number, slot index or year.

cases.name: array-order-preserved
cases.note: Array order is meaningful and is never sorted.

cases.name: key-sort-is-code-unit-not-locale
cases.note: UTF-16 code unit order, so uppercase sorts before underscore, which sorts before lowercase. A locale-aware sort fails this.

cases.name: empty-containers
cases.note: Empty object, empty array and empty string are all representable and distinct.

cases.name: numbers-ecmascript-tostring
cases.note: JCS mandates ECMAScript Number::toString: 1.0 emits as 1, negative zero as 0, 1e21 as 1e+21.

cases.name: nested-mixed
cases.note: Objects inside arrays inside objects; each object sorted, each array left alone.

cases.name: unicode-and-escapes
cases.note: Minimal escaping, non-ASCII emitted literally, astral characters intact.

cases.name: numeric-string-values-are-not-keys
cases.note: Guards against an over-eager fix: the defect is about keys, so numeric string VALUES must not be touched.

cases.name: vg-grade-payload-shape
cases.note: A realistic Grade payload, to pin the shape the envelope actually carries.
